_readme.format: Every entry of "plan" is executed once, in order, isolated from the others.

fields.name: Friendly label used in the logs and in the final report.
fields.timeout: Seconds before the whole process tree is killed.
fields.optional: true = a failure is logged as WARNING and never aborts the plan.
fields.accepted_exit_codes: Non-zero exit codes that must be treated as success.
fields.enabled: false = keep the entry documented but do not run it.
fields.input: Text sent to the command; use "input_mode": "pipe" for cmd pipes.

notes: Explorer icon-cache commands must NOT be declared here: the application runs a dedicated internal workflow at the end of the plan.
%WO_PROTECTED_PATHS% is exported by the application and lists paths the cleanup must never delete (the running source tree, the Python interpreter and the log folder).

plan.name: Clear user TEMP folder
plan.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $protected = @(); if ($env:WO_PROTECTED_PATHS) { $protected = $env:WO_PROTECTED_PATHS.Split(';') | Where-Object { $_ } }; $removed = 0; $kept = 0; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:TEMP -Force | Where-Object { -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) } | ForEach-Object { $full = $_.FullName; $skip = $false; foreach ($p in $protected) { if ($full -eq $p -or $full.StartsWith($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or $p.StartsWith($full, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $skip = $true; break } }; if ($skip) { $kept++ } else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $full -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { $removed++ } } }; Write-Output ('TEMP cleanup finished. Removed: {0} | Kept (in use or protected): {1}' -f $removed, $kept); exit 0
plan.description: Delete the contents of the user TEMP folder, skipping reparse points, locked items and the paths listed in %WO_PROTECTED_PATHS% (the application's own files).

plan.name: Repair Windows image (DISM)
plan.description: Repair the component store before running SFC. Exit codes 3010/1641 only mean a reboot is required.

plan.name: System File Checker (SFC)
plan.description: Scan and repair protected system files.

plan.name: Online disk check
plan.description: Online NTFS scan that queues any repair for the next boot. Replaces the interactive "chkdsk /f /r", which stopped the whole plan waiting for a localized Y/N answer that could never be piped reliably.

plan.name: Update installed programs (winget)
plan.description: Upgrade every package known to winget. {winget} is resolved to the real winget.exe path because the WindowsApps alias is often missing in an elevated session.
